== Vectors ==

=== Mathematical definition ===

A set of vectors $\{\vec{v}_1, \vec{v}_2, \dots, \vec{v}_n\}$ is '''linearly independent''' if

$$
c_1 \vec{v}_1 + c_2 \vec{v}_2 + \cdots + c_n \vec{v}_n = \vec{0}
$$

has no solution besides

$$
c_1, c_2, \cdots, c_n = 0.
$$

=== Equivalent definition ===

Equivalently, it can be stated that if 

$$
\forall i,j \in \{1,n\} \vec v_i \neq \sum \lambda\vec v_j \\
\text{(no vector in the set can be written as a linear combination of some others)}
$$

then set of vectors $\{\vec{v}_1, \vec{v}_2, \dots, \vec{v}_n\}$ is '''linearly independent'''
